b1-allamszervezet-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The National Assembly
b1-allamszervezet-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the National Assembly.
b1-allamszervezet-01.prompt: Say how many members the National Assembly has and for how many years they are elected.
b1-allamszervezet-01.target: Az Országgyűlés 199 képviselőből áll. Négy évre választják meg őket.
b1-allamszervezet-01.english: The National Assembly has 199 members. They are elected for four years.
b1-allamszervezet-01.canDo: I can say how many members the Hungarian National Assembly has and for how many years they are elected.

b1-allamszervezet-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The President
b1-allamszervezet-02.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the head of state.
b1-allamszervezet-02.prompt: Say who elects the President, for how many years, and what the President commands.
cues: Say who elects the President and for how long
Say what the President is commander of
b1-allamszervezet-02.target: A köztársasági elnököt az Országgyűlés választja meg öt évre. Ő a Magyar Honvédség főparancsnoka.
b1-allamszervezet-02.english: The National Assembly elects the President for five years. He or she is the commander-in-chief of the Hungarian Defence Forces.
b1-allamszervezet-02.canDo: I can say who the head of state is, how the President is chosen and for how many years.

b1-allamszervezet-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Government
b1-allamszervezet-03.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the Government.
b1-allamszervezet-03.prompt: Say who leads the Government and who elects the Prime Minister.
cues: Say who elects the Prime Minister
b1-allamszervezet-03.target: A Kormányt a miniszterelnök vezeti. Az Országgyűlés választja meg a miniszterelnököt.
b1-allamszervezet-03.english: The Prime Minister leads the Government. The National Assembly elects the Prime Minister.
b1-allamszervezet-03.canDo: I can say who leads the Government and how the Prime Minister and the ministers are chosen.

b1-allamszervezet-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Courts
b1-allamszervezet-04.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the courts.
b1-allamszervezet-04.prompt: Say what the highest court is called and say that judges cannot be members of a party.
b1-allamszervezet-04.target: A legfelsőbb bíróság a Kúria. A bírák nem lehetnek pártok tagjai.
b1-allamszervezet-04.english: The highest court is the Curia. Judges cannot be members of parties.
b1-allamszervezet-04.canDo: I can name the four levels of Hungarian courts and say which is the highest.

b1-allamszervezet-05.title: Communicative Challenge: How a Law Is Made
b1-allamszervezet-05.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about how laws are made.
b1-allamszervezet-05.prompt: Say where a law officially appears and what the referendum is.
cues: Say what the national referendum is
b1-allamszervezet-05.target: A törvény a Magyar Közlönyben jelenik meg. Az országos népszavazás a közvetlen demokrácia.
b1-allamszervezet-05.english: The law appears in the Magyar Közlöny. The national referendum is direct democracy.
b1-allamszervezet-05.canDo: I can describe in simple words how a bill becomes a law in Hungary.

b1-allamszervezet-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Does What
b1-allamszervezet-consolidation.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the main state bodies.
b1-allamszervezet-consolidation.prompt: Say who elects the President and to whom the Government is accountable.
cues: Say to whom the Government is accountable
b1-allamszervezet-consolidation.target: Az Országgyűlés választja meg a köztársasági elnököt. A Kormány az Országgyűlésnek felelős.
b1-allamszervezet-consolidation.english: The National Assembly elects the President. The Government is accountable to the National Assembly.
b1-allamszervezet-consolidation.canDo: I can explain which state body does what in Hungary.

b1-onkormanyzat-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Local Self-Government
b1-onkormanyzat-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about local government.
b1-onkormanyzat-01.prompt: Say who decides local public affairs and how many districts Budapest has.
cues: Say how many districts Budapest has
b1-onkormanyzat-01.target: A helyi közügyekről a helyi közösség dönt. Budapestnek huszonhárom kerülete van.
b1-onkormanyzat-01.english: The local community decides local public affairs. Budapest has twenty-three districts.
b1-onkormanyzat-01.canDo: I can explain municipal autonomy and self-governance in Hungary.

b1-onkormanyzat-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Mayor and the Clerk
b1-onkormanyzat-02.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the mayor and the town hall.
b1-onkormanyzat-02.prompt: Say for how many years the mayor is elected and who is responsible for the office.
cues: Say for how long the mayor is elected
Say who is responsible for the office
b1-onkormanyzat-02.target: A polgármestert öt évre választják meg. A hivatalért a jegyző felel.
b1-onkormanyzat-02.english: The mayor is elected for five years. The town clerk is responsible for the office.
b1-onkormanyzat-02.canDo: I can describe the election and powers of the mayor and Lord Mayor.

b1-onkormanyzat-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Counties
b1-onkormanyzat-03.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the counties.
b1-onkormanyzat-03.prompt: Say how many counties Hungary has and name a city with county rights.
cues: Name a city with county rights
b1-onkormanyzat-03.target: Magyarországnak tizenkilenc megyéje van. Debrecen megyei jogú város.
b1-onkormanyzat-03.english: Hungary has nineteen counties. Debrecen is a city with county rights.
b1-onkormanyzat-03.canDo: I can say that Hungary has nineteen counties plus the capital.

b1-onkormanyzat-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Government Window
b1-onkormanyzat-04.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about the offices that deal with citizens.
b1-onkormanyzat-04.prompt: Say where citizens can arrange their official affairs and who heads the county government office.
cues: Say where citizens arrange their affairs
Say who heads the county office
b1-onkormanyzat-04.target: Az állampolgárok a kormányablakban intézhetik az ügyeiket. A megyei kormányhivatalt a kormánymegbízott vezeti.
b1-onkormanyzat-04.english: Citizens can arrange their affairs at the government window. The county government office is headed by the government commissioner.
b1-onkormanyzat-04.canDo: I can distinguish elected self-governments from central state administrative offices.

b1-onkormanyzat-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Local Democracy
b1-onkormanyzat-05.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about local democracy.
b1-onkormanyzat-05.prompt: Say that the council holds a public hearing every year and that residents can start a local referendum.
cues: Say what the council holds every year
b1-onkormanyzat-05.target: A képviselő-testület évente közmeghallgatást tart. A lakosok helyi népszavazást kezdeményezhetnek.
b1-onkormanyzat-05.english: The council holds a public hearing every year. Residents can initiate a local referendum.
b1-onkormanyzat-05.canDo: I can identify essential municipal services: water, lighting, waste, kindergartens.

b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Runs the Town
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview, and the officer asks about local government.
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.prompt: Say who leads the municipality and who is responsible for the office.
cues: Say who is responsible for the office
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.target: A települést a polgármester és a képviselő-testület vezeti. A hivatalért a jegyző felel.
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.english: The mayor and the council lead the municipality. The town clerk is responsible for the office.
b1-onkormanyzat-consolidation.canDo: I can explain how Hungarian local government and public administration work.

b1-nemzetiertekek-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Nobel Prize Winners
b1-nemzetiertekek-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview. Your teacher asks which Hungarian scientist received a Nobel Prize for work on Vitamin C.
b1-nemzetiertekek-01.prompt: Tell your teacher who was awarded the Nobel Prize for the Vitamin C research, in which year, and in which field.
cues: Say what kind of Nobel Prize it was
b1-nemzetiertekek-01.target: Szent-Györgyi Albertet 1937-ben tüntették ki orvosi Nobel-díjjal a C-vitamin kutatásáért.
b1-nemzetiertekek-01.english: Albert Szent-Györgyi was awarded the Nobel Prize in Medicine in 1937 for his Vitamin C research.
b1-nemzetiertekek-01.canDo: I can name Hungarian Nobel Prize winners and say what they were awarded for.

b1-nemzetiertekek-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Saviour of Mothers
b1-nemzetiertekek-02.scenario: On a museum visit, the guide asks you who is known as the saviour of mothers and why.
b1-nemzetiertekek-02.prompt: Tell the guide who is known as the saviour of mothers and what he introduced in hospitals.
cues: Name the doctor and say how he is known
b1-nemzetiertekek-02.target: Semmelweis Ignácot az anyák megmentőjeként tartják számon, mert bevezette a kézmosást a kórházban.
b1-nemzetiertekek-02.english: Ignác Semmelweis is regarded as the saviour of mothers because he introduced handwashing in hospital.
b1-nemzetiertekek-02.canDo: I can name Hungarian inventions and their inventors, from the dynamo to the Rubik's Cube.

b1-nemzetiertekek-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Collecting Folk Songs
b1-nemzetiertekek-03.scenario: At a music class, your teacher asks what Bartók and Kodály did in the Hungarian villages.
b1-nemzetiertekek-03.prompt: Tell your teacher what Bartók and Kodály collected, and what the collecting contributed to.
cues: Say what they collected in the villages
b1-nemzetiertekek-03.target: Bartók és Kodály népdalokat gyűjtöttek a magyar falvakban. A népdalgyűjtés hozzájárult a népdalok megőrzéséhez.
b1-nemzetiertekek-03.english: Bartók and Kodály collected folk songs in the Hungarian villages. The collecting contributed to preserving the folk songs.
b1-nemzetiertekek-03.canDo: I can name Hungarian composers and say what each is known for.

b1-nemzetiertekek-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Poets and Painters
b1-nemzetiertekek-04.scenario: In a literature class, your teacher asks who wrote the Toldi trilogy and who painted the Golgota.
b1-nemzetiertekek-04.prompt: Tell your teacher which poet wrote the Toldi trilogy and which painter made the Golgota.
cues: Name the poet of the Toldi trilogy
Name the painter of the Golgota
b1-nemzetiertekek-04.target: A Toldi-trilógiát Arany János írta, a Golgotát pedig Munkácsy Mihály festette.
b1-nemzetiertekek-04.english: János Arany wrote the Toldi trilogy, and Mihály Munkácsy painted the Golgota.
b1-nemzetiertekek-04.canDo: I can name well-known Hungarian poets and painters and say what each is known for.

b1-nemzetiertekek-05.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is a Hungarikum?
b1-nemzetiertekek-05.scenario: A Hungarian friend at a wine tasting asks what a Hungarikum is and gives you a bottle of Tokaji aszú.
b1-nemzetiertekek-05.prompt: Tell your friend what a Hungarikum is and say that Tokaji aszú was declared one.
cues: Say what was declared a Hungarikum
b1-nemzetiertekek-05.target: A Tokaji aszút hungarikummá nyilvánították. A hungarikum hivatalosan elismert, különleges magyar nemzeti érték.
b1-nemzetiertekek-05.english: Tokaji aszú was declared a Hungarikum. A Hungarikum is an officially recognised, distinctive Hungarian national value.
b1-nemzetiertekek-05.canDo: I can name Hungarian heritage values (Hungarikums) and say what each is.

b1-nemzetiertekek-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Hungarian Culture Interview
b1-nemzetiertekek-consolidation.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview. The examiner asks you to name three things that Hungary is known for in science, music and heritage.
b1-nemzetiertekek-consolidation.prompt: Name a Nobel Prize winner, a composer and a Hungarikum.
cues: Name a scientist and his prize
b1-nemzetiertekek-consolidation.target: Szent-Györgyi Albert orvosi Nobel-díjat kapott. Liszt Ferenc zeneszerző volt. A Tokaji aszú hungarikum.
b1-nemzetiertekek-consolidation.english: Albert Szent-Györgyi received the Nobel Prize in Medicine. Ferenc Liszt was a composer. Tokaji aszú is a Hungarikum.
b1-nemzetiertekek-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about Hungarian science, inventions, music, literature and Hungarikums.

b1-europaiorokseg-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Authors and Their Works
b1-europaiorokseg-01.scenario: In a literature class, your teacher asks who wrote the Faust and who translated Hamlet into Hungarian.
b1-europaiorokseg-01.prompt: Tell your teacher who wrote the Faust and who translated Shakespeare's Hamlet into Hungarian.
cues: Name the author of the Faust
b1-europaiorokseg-01.target: A Faustot Goethe írta, Shakespeare Hamletjét pedig Arany János fordította magyarra.
b1-europaiorokseg-01.english: Goethe wrote the Faust, and Arany János translated Shakespeare's Hamlet into Hungarian.
b1-europaiorokseg-01.canDo: I can name famous works of European literature and their authors, from Homer to Goethe.

b1-europaiorokseg-02.title: Communicative Challenge: A Dickens Novel
b1-europaiorokseg-02.scenario: At a book club, a friend asks what Dickens's novel Oliver Twist shows.
b1-europaiorokseg-02.prompt: Tell your friend what Dickens presents in the novel Oliver Twist.
cues: Name the author and the novel
b1-europaiorokseg-02.target: Dickens a Twist Olivérben az árvaságot mutatja be.
b1-europaiorokseg-02.english: In Oliver Twist, Dickens presents the plight of orphans.
b1-europaiorokseg-02.canDo: I can name famous 19th-century novels and their authors, from Pushkin to Tolstoy.

b1-europaiorokseg-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Himnusz and Its Music
b1-europaiorokseg-03.scenario: At a music school, your teacher asks who set the Himnusz to music and when.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.prompt: Tell your teacher who set Kölcsey's Himnusz to music, and in which year.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.target: Erkel Ferenc 1844-ben megzenésítette Kölcsey Ferenc Himnuszát.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.english: Ferenc Erkel set Ferenc Kölcsey's Himnusz to music in 1844.
b1-europaiorokseg-03.canDo: I can name famous composers and their works, from Bach to Liszt.

b1-europaiorokseg-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Hungarian Ballad
b1-europaiorokseg-04.scenario: In a Hungarian literature class, your teacher asks who wrote A walesi bárdok and what the ballad is about.
b1-europaiorokseg-04.prompt: Tell your teacher who wrote the ballad A walesi bárdok and what it is about.
cues: Say what the ballad is about
b1-europaiorokseg-04.target: A walesi bárdok című balladát Arany János írta. A ballada a zsarnokságról szól.
b1-europaiorokseg-04.english: Arany János wrote the ballad A walesi bárdok. The ballad is about tyranny.
b1-europaiorokseg-04.canDo: I can name the classics of Hungarian literature and their best-known works.

b1-europaiorokseg-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Nobel Prize in Literature
b1-europaiorokseg-05.scenario: At the library, a librarian asks which Hungarian writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature and when.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.prompt: Tell the librarian which Hungarian writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature, and in which year.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.target: Kertész Imre 2002-ben elnyerte az irodalmi Nobel-díjat.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.english: Imre Kertész won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2002.
b1-europaiorokseg-05.canDo: I can name the writers of the Nyugat generation and later Hungarian authors and their works.

b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Culture Quiz
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.scenario: At a school quiz about European and Hungarian culture, the quiz master asks you to name a composer and a writer, each with a work or prize.
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.prompt: Say who composed the Ode to Joy and which Hungarian writer won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
cues: Name the composer and the work
Name the writer and the prize
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.target: Az Örömóda dallamát Beethoven szerezte. Kertész Imre elnyerte az irodalmi Nobel-díjat.
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.english: Beethoven composed the melody of the Ode to Joy. Imre Kertész won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
b1-europaiorokseg-consolidation.canDo: I can talk about European and Hungarian literature and music and their best-known works.
